image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched amidst a dense thicket of leafless, thorny branches. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast, and dark upperparts with white markings on the wings. The background consists of out-of-focus vertical branches, creating a shallow depth of field.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification (Fringilla montifringilla) and rule out similar finches like Bullfinch or Chaffinch.
To verify that the complex occlusion between the bird and the dense thorny branches is physically correct and there is no edge bleeding or fusion.
To assess overall image quality, noise levels, and ensure the texture of the feathers and branches is consistent with optical photography rather than AI generation.
To ensure the depth of field (bokeh) in the background is geometrically consistent with the focal plane of the bird.

focus_areas: Feather-edge integrity against complex branch background
Anatomical correctness of feet gripping the branch
Color consistency of breeding plumage (black/orange contrast)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the bird's feet and the thin branches. AI often fails to render slender toes wrapping correctly around irregular perches. Also, verify that the white wing bars do not 'bleed' into the black feathers or the background branches.
